as_told.title: Townsend Brown, time travel and Bahnson's high-voltage anomalies

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who studied strange effects of high voltage, believed his work had clear implications for time travel, and was obsessed with it. Michels says this himself in two episodes, without naming a source; in the second he adds that Agnew Bahnson, a businessman who funded Brown, said similar things about anomalies at high voltage. If true, it would mean early anti-gravity research was thought to touch on time itself.
